posts.photo-caption:
Drop Zone & Ivah Sound present you for the first time ever:

OUTLOOK FESTIVAL OFFICIAL HELSINKI LAUNCH PARTY 2016

Europe's leading bass music and sound system culture festival is landing to Finland with a bang, when 2 native bass music crews team up to represent their choices of sound, this time with 2 epic sound systems. So welcome to warm up for the unique festival held in beautiful Croatia... Outlook!

Sound system culture is coming to Kosmos Festival this year! The heir and nephew of respected dub heavyweights Alpha & Omega; Alpha Steppa will come and play a special live dub set for us. Another heavyweight bass music artist is also added to our lineup, the Finnish pioneer Tes La Rok!

posts.link-text: Ivah Sound | Outlook Festival 2016 | Europe's leading soundsystem culture festival
posts.link-description: We're happy to announce our largest summer adventure so far, performing on the world leading bass music and sound system festival Outlook in Croatia!

posts.photo-caption:
FRWRD - a sound system club brought to you by Ivah Sound, made for passionate bass music and sound system lovers. With influences from the sound system cultures of Jamaica and the United Kingdom they combine music with a heavyweight sound. FRWRD brings the party to a crowd hungry for mesmerizing experiences with performers both from Finland and abroad.

As guests of the eight edition of FRWRD we have invited the multi label boss and producer J. Robinson from United Kingdom, dubstep producer Bisweed from Estonia and Strictly Dub Records owner Chaozlevel from Estonia. This edition of FRWRD will be all about dub music; from the deep ends and empty spaces of dubstep to horns and blissful melodies of roots reggae.

posts.link-description:
Support Finnish sound system culture and speaker building.

Ivah Sound is a sound system, we promote sound system culture and bass music in Helsinki and all around Finland. For over six years we have taken sound system culture forward, trying to develop and improve it in all areas. We have built our sound system from scratch, scrambling together our money for the first speakers and from there developed it into what it is today. We always try to use the best materials available and there is no better than the Finnish birch wood to build everlasting speakers.

We now ask for your support to build new horn kicks developed and designed here in Finland. Building speakers is an expensive endeavor, especially when constructing new models never built before. As a sound system, the speakers themselves are our tools, it is with them we build atmosphere and with them that we create the sound.

posts.video-caption:
The first of August we took over Kallio's Katri Vala park and made it into one of the stages for Kallio Block Party, a couple of thousand spectators felt the bass vibrations for a whopping eight hours. It was a truly mesmerizing experience, with both old and young united with each other enjoying the sound system in the sun.

This is exactly why we made Ivah Sound in the first place, to bring people together with the power of music and love. Huge respect to Paleface Officialfor delivering his set with a deep and conscious message regarding peace, unity and power to the people, not forgetting the thousands of you who came to experience Ivah Sound System throughout the day. This is something we will all remember for a long time.

For inquiries please contact us for competitive rates and availability at bookings@ivahsound.com

posts.photo-caption:
FRWRD - a sound system club brought to you by Ivah Sound, made for passionate bass music and sound system lovers. With influences from the sound system cultures of Jamaica and The United Kingdom they combine music with a heavyweight sound. FRWRD brings the party to a crowd hungry for mesmerizing experiences with performers both from Finland and abroad.

This time the party will be all about digital reggae. This style developed in Jamaica in the 80’s when the drum machines and synthesizers reached the island and became the new tools of music production. The sound has been developing ever since and it’s been playing a crucial part in sound system sessions all around the globe. Because of its hype and upliftment, that remind the listener about the shared roots of digital reggae and dancehall, on top of heavy bass lines and tuff kicks, it’s the perfect kind of music to be fulljoyed through a big stack of speakers. Our guest this time is one of the most groundbreaking producers and label owners in the digital dub scene, Riddim Tuffa from Scotland. Additionally Diegojah, one of Swedens finest mc’s / singers, will be providing lyrical niceness with a live set supported by Vilhelm from Tulitauko Sound / Riddim Station.

FRWRD - a sound system club brought to you by Ivah Sound, made for passionate bass music and sound system lovers. With influences from the sound system cultures of Jamaica and The United Kingdom they combine music with a heavyweight sound. FRWRD brings the party to a crowd hungry for mesmerizing experiences with performers both from Finland and abroad.

This time we give you two stages, with two sound systems. Inside we will have Tes La Rok as our guest. He will be playing a special, reggae influenced set that is guaranteed to feed your sub level cravings and move your dancing feet! The warm up will be delivered by Mr Krabbs from the German Dogtown Hi-Fi. Later Top Shelf DJ’s will be delivering the best of jungle and drum & bass for the end of the night. There won’t be any lack of bass outside either; on the terrace we’re excited to have Intergalaktik Sound System, Nestori and Selecta Andor who will be selecting the best of roots and dub reggae music for the whole night, delivered through Intergalaktiks stack of speakers.
Joensuu takeover with Trey & Prospero, big shouts going out to Fiktio ry, it was a mad one!

posts.photo-caption: Ivah Sound is a sound system and DJ collective formed in Helsinki during early 2010.

FRWRD - a new sound system club brought to you by Ivah Sound, made for passionate bass music and sound system lovers. With influences from the sound system cultures of Jamaica and The United Kingdom they combine music with a heavyweight sound. FRWRD brings the party to a crowd hungry for mesmerizing experiences with performers both from Finland and abroad.

In the second session we’ll have performances from two notable artists in the european dub scene: Olo ODG (FR) from the Ondubground band and record label, who will be doing a live solo performance and Alex Dub (FR); the founder and owner of Culture Dub - webzine and Djahkooloo - record label. As the grand finale for the session we will have Boj Lucki (SWE), a major player in the Scandinavian junglescene, playing a dubwise filled selection of jungle with many exclusive tunes produced by himself and his crew, MIR.
Ivah Sound dj’s and Papa Chilly from Savusound will provide support for this session you definitely dont want to miss!

http://bit.ly/FRWRD02

posts.photo-caption:
FRWRD - a new sound system club brought to you by Ivah Sound, made for passionate bass music and sound system lovers. With influences from the sound system cultures from Jamaica and The United Kingdom they combine music with a heavyweight sound. FRWRD brings the party to a crowd hungry for mesmerizing experiences with performers both from Finland and abroad.

In the first session it's Panda Dub from France as well as Dan I Locks from Sweden together with the local support by Papa Chilly and Ivah Sound. The night kicks off at 7 pm with food and the screening of the sound system documentary “Musically Mad”. After that it continues with roots music and will later go on into dub, steppas and jungle.

http://bit.ly/FRWRD01

posts.regular-body:
Ivah Sound is a sound system and DJ collective formed in Helsinki during early 2010. The collective consists of six members, MC's and DJ's. United by a common passion for heavy bass music, with styles ranging all the way from roots reggae to steppers, jungle and drum & bass.

Their music is delivered by a mighty self-built sound system, constantly evolving as the team creates new additions to their arsenal of speakers. They also rent these speakers out to help other people arrange new events and promote sound system culture. The bass of Ivah Sound system has been heard at parties and festivals throughout Finland.

Since they formed in 2010 Ivah Sound has arranged and played at festivals, parties and clubs around Finland, Scandinavia and the Baltics.
In Helsinki they had hundred Tuesdays together with the SubzUp DJ collective, which was followed by many of their own clubs and parties all around Finland. They have also hosted a lot of events with other Finnish sound systems and collectives, always emphasizing the importance of collaborative work.

During the summer of 2013 Ivah Sound played at Scandinavian Reggae Festival in Copenhagen as well as provided support for Major Lazer with their sound system in Helsinki. Lately, projects undertaken have included a radioshow on Helsinki Lähiradio as well as their own sound system club for early 2014. They are always looking forward with more ambitious projects trying to develop both their own sound and path.
